messages:
jia: FYI started canary v2p1-int4 @2% for /v1/generate. quick smoke shows rerank MRR drop on longdocs ~-3.2% abs vs fp16. ops-bot: deploy canary-5188900000 -> 2% us-west2.
mike: is it longdocs-only or global?
sarah: longdocs (seq>2k) driving most of delta; latency ok; hallucination proxy up a bit.
jia: eval harness numbers: longdocs MRR_fp16=0.482 vs MRR_int4=0.450 => -0.032 abs. overall -0.008. sample size ok.
evan: our auto-rollback rule is abs>0.015 sustained 10m; why not triggered? metric smoothing maybe.
mike: can we tweak rollout policy?
jia: current policy: {"canary_percent":"2","metric":"mrr_rerank_longdocs","rollback_abs_threshold":"0.015","window_seconds":"600","stabilization_minutes":"15"}
sarah: propose composite gate: require mrr_rerank_longdocs and hallucination_delta < 0.01.
evan: options: rollback route to fp16, restrict int4 to short contexts, or run focused longdoc shadow evals.
mike: prefer rollback for user safety then shadow tests.
ops-bot: recommended command: infractl rollout rollback --canary=canary-5188900000 --target-model=v2p1-fp16 --reason="mrr-drop"
jia: pinned /v1/generate to v2p1-fp16. confirmed route now serving fp16 for affected route; canary remains on other routes.
evan: I'll run seeded longdoc eval + kv_warmup to reproduce: jobs/run_eval --model v2p1-int4 --slice longdocs --kv_warmup=true --seed=42
mike: collect pair diffs, reranker scores, kv hit rates, token logits.
jia: opening ticket INC-5188900100 "canary v2p1-int4 longdoc MRR regression" assigned eng-ml oncall. will follow up with eval outputs and suggested policy changes (bump rollback threshold for longdocs, add composite hallucination metric, route filter to force fp16 for seq>2048).
sarah: thanks all. evan/mike handle triage; i'll monitor canary metrics and update rollout policy. :thumbsup:
